consumptionData.methodology: Yamaha publishes a combined fuel-consumption value. Category rates are estimated around that value: urban is higher for frequent acceleration, interurban is lower for steady running, motorway is higher for sustained high speed, and unknown uses the published combined value.

sources.title: XMAX 300 2025 specifications
sources.notes: Used for 2025 model, 292 cc displacement, and 3.0 L/100 km combined fuel consumption.
